components.name: spending_discipline
components.formula: min(100, budget / variable spending * 100); unknown without explicit budget

components.name: payment_readiness
components.formula: clip(checking / next full month scheduled bills * 100, 0, 100)

health.note: Prototype wellness heuristic, not a credit score. Missing components are excluded and weights renormalized. Stability currently measures surplus, not income volatility.

forecast.aggregation_note: Summed daily medians are a planning total, not an expected total or calibrated quantile of horizon spending.
forecast.uncertainty: Daily empirical 10th/90th quantiles; accumulated bounds are stress envelopes, not calibrated balance intervals.
assumptions: Income routed to checking for projection; savings kept separate.
Monthly bills inferred from last 90 days; backend should supply actual schedules.
Card purchases modeled as immediate cash outflows; card payments excluded to avoid duplication.
Other debt payments use snapshot amounts; external calibration transfers excluded.

snapshot.source: FRED current-revised cache; historical vintage availability unverified

conditions.method: transparent observed-condition rules; no trained-classifier accuracy claim
conditions.note: Prototype thresholds, not validated regime labels. Steady means no configured stress flag, not a healthy economy or future gains.

economy.formula: 50% inflation/8 + 25% policy rate/8 + 25% unemployment/10; each capped at 1, times 100
economy.note: Design-assumption pressure index, not personal job-loss probability. Cost impact is a hypothetical year-over-year stress, not a monthly forecast.
